props.headline: Why *group* attendance matters
props.subline: Group treatment is the standard of care for substance use disorder and one of the most powerful tools we have to help patients heal, grow, and prepare for life after treatment.

props.headline: Four reasons to *show* *up*
props.subline: What groups give a patient, session after session.

items.title: Connection over isolation
items.text: Addiction thrives in isolation. Groups are a safe space to connect, share experiences, and feel understood.

items.title: Accountability in action
items.text: Showing up demonstrates a commitment to recovery and builds trust and reliability within the community.

items.title: Skills and confidence
items.text: Practice coping skills, gain feedback, and build confidence for life outside our walls.

items.title: Healthy structure
items.text: A group schedule brings the stability, routine, and healthy structure that early recovery needs.

props.headline: Stronger, more confident, better *prepared*
props.subline: When patients engage fully in groups, they leave treatment stronger, more confident, and better prepared to succeed in recovery.

props.headline: Your energy sets the *tone*
props.subline: In every interaction, encourage patients to show up, even on hard days. Remind them that groups are practice for life after treatment, and celebrate their consistency and effort, not just attendance.
